integration_notes: Add server_kind 'qa' to mcp_manager/client.py SERVERS (server_file targets/qa/mcp_server.py, env_var QA_URL, default_url http://localhost:8103) and to its TOOL_SPECS from tool_specs below; mirror the same entry in orchestrator/tools.py TOOL_SPECS + _BASE_URLS.
Path params used by tool paths: failure_id, run_id — orchestrator/tools.py _PATH_PARAMS must learn both names for the direct fallback.

Job posting: translate jobs.json templates into engine Family entries (key/title/brief/budget/criteria) with department 'qa'; the worker executor dispatches on family key exactly like the TicketDesk families, calling only the tools in each template's tools_expected.
Reviewer: checks.py exposes CHECKS[family_key](call, criterion, **args) with the same finding shape as engine.verify() — wire it into the review step for qa jobs.
mcp_server.py is the generated-style stand-in for `synapse build --local --auto`, identical in construction to TicketDesk's (the pattern this repo actually runs). See synapse_status.

reset.behaviour: Deletes qa.db and reseeds the exact seeded dataset (6 runs, 25 failures, no clusters/quarantines/verdicts/notes). Same semantics as TicketDesk's reset.
reset.endpoint: POST /admin/reset (internal — NOT exposed as a tool)

service.health: GET /health (internal — NOT exposed as a tool)

tools.description: List CI runs, newest first, each with failure_count, new_failure_count and any recorded regression verdict.
tools.name: read_list_runs

tools.description: List failures filtered by run / suite / status / signature / test name / cluster; each shows its cluster assignment and whether its signature is new in its run.
tools.name: read_list_failures

tools.description: Fetch one failure with its cluster, the full pass/fail history of its test across all runs, signature stats (first-seen run, totals) and the test's quarantine state.
tools.name: read_get_failure_detail

tools.description: Group unclustered failures by error signature: creates one cluster per signature and assigns every matching failure to it (optionally only within one run). Confirm-gated.
tools.name: write_cluster_failures

tools.description: Mark a test as flaky and quarantine it; its open failures move to status 'quarantined'. Confirm-gated.
tools.name: write_quarantine_test

tools.description: Record a run's regression verdict ('regression' | 'no_regression'); a non-empty note is stored as a triage note on the run. Confirm-gated.
tools.name: write_set_regression_verdict

tools.description: Add a triage note to a failure, cluster, run, or test. Confirm-gated.
tools.name: write_add_triage_note
